sourceAnchors.message: Avoid catching RuntimeException in try-catch block
sourceAnchors.reason: SS333 ownership arbitration must close on all Java checked I/O, RuntimeException and Error paths. Winners leave by their original identity except the fixed redaction of I/O. The catch does not consume an unexpected failure.

sourceAnchors.reason: SS333 explicitly uses the pair of primary and secondary I/O classifications. The check selects the required identity winner and retains safe suppression; ordinary TWR priority would not implement the same contract.

sourceAnchors.reason: SS333 preserves a known Storage reason only for an unaccompanied typed I/O failure. The negative compound and unknown class use the fixed redacted reason, with no provider detail.
